summary: Frontend-only regression on PXC site (21 routes). All 20 specified routes render with header+footer and correct H1 content. Services dropdown contains all 30+ items (3 tools, 7 services, 4 states, 16 counties + overview). Home hero, Events rebrand, MED-AI Studio, AI Readiness Score interactive flow, mobile hamburger, and tablet responsive all verified working. Only minor issues noted below.

issues: BODY content correctly uses ONLY gold/black/grey/white (AI Blueprint Day logo centered, Jennifer image with gold overlay, gold CTAs). HOWEVER the global site Header is still rendered on /events with red Book CTA, cyan 'Events' active link, and lilac nav links. Per the strict requirement 'NO red, NO purple, NO cyan ANYWHERE on Events', the Header should arguably swap to gold palette when location.pathname === '/events'. Currently it does not. Flagging for product clarification — Events body palette itself is correct.

action_items: (Optional/clarify) Decide whether the global Header should swap to gold/charcoal palette on /events route to satisfy 'no red/cyan/lilac anywhere'. Body content of Events page already complies.
Investigate a single 404 console warning on home (likely /assets/heartbeat.mp4 or favicon). Non-blocking; hero still renders the beating-stethoscope graphic and rotating rings video card correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx route registration is clean; ServicesRouter correctly dispatches /services/:slug to ServiceDetail vs StatePage vs CountyPage.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes (button-services-menu, aireadiness-start, button-mobile-menu, link-county-*, link-state-*, link-service-*, link-tool-*) — excellent testability.
No console pageerrors, no React error boundaries, no infinite loaders observed across all 20 routes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% routes load; 1 minor palette interpretation flag

context_for_next_testing_agent: Direct URL navigation to many routes in rapid succession triggers Cloudflare/security verification (403). Use SPA client-side navigation via window.history.pushState + popstate dispatch for batch route testing, or insert delays between full goto() calls. The site is Wouter-based SPA. All data-testid selectors are reliable.
